response.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount FROM scanfeatures WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL), s AS (SELECT zoneref, traitcount, traitcount * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(traitcount) FROM f) AS share FROM f) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, traitcount AS feature_count, share, share - (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) AS margin_above_avg FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT AVG(share) FROM s) ORDER BY margin_above_avg DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Share is expressed as a fraction (0 to 1) of the total traitcount over records with non-null traitcount, not as a percentage.
The average share is taken over the same non-null records, so it equals 1 divided by the number of those records.
Each scanfeatures record is kept separate, so a site code can appear more than once.
